issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the appellant not credible about the June 17, 2017 attack and police complaint
issues.applicant_position: The contradictions are minor; fear of reprisals explains why the passenger was left out of the police complaint.
issues.result_text: Inconsistencies and contradictions about the key attack undermine credibility; the RPD did not err.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant's delay in claiming and his business-related conduct undermine credibility
issues.applicant_position: Delay is not determinative of credibility; he did not contact his partner because he was hiding.
issues.result_text: Court agrees with the RPD's credibility finding on the business risk allegations.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant faces a personalized prospective risk if returned to Haiti
issues.applicant_position: The RPD wrongly found no prospective risk; the evidence shows an objective risk to his life.
issues.result_text: RPD did not err: the appellant failed to prove a personalized risk to life or cruel punishment in Haiti.
